evals.name: split-whole-reel-from-reference
evals.prompt: monta no capcut o reel "o celular não precisa ouvir". criei o projeto vazio "04-celular não precisa ouvir" e fechei o capcut. o corte, as cenas, o sfx e a legenda tão na pasta do reel. quero abrir e já estar pronto, como eu faria à mão.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: build the sandbox with .scratch/finishing-reels-workspace/setup_run.sh <run> celular (drafts/ with a copy of the empty project made in the app plus the author's Jev-AI, whatsapp-tintas, arquitetura-desce and arquiteto-dev-piramide drafts; reel/ with the cut, legenda.srt, words.json, timeline.md, exports/01-dossie-topo.mov and 00-sfx.wav, without the divider). Run with run_eval.sh from a folder outside the repo, so no project memory loads. Grade the written draft with inspect_draft.py against the project the author approved and posted (CapCut drafts/04-celular não precisa ouvir).
evals.expected_output: Before writing, a check that CapCut is closed and a backup of the empty project. The draft copies style from the author's reference project (Jev-AI, named as reference in timeline.md): the 'Balançar para cima e para a direita' entrance on the first clip, the camera click at 0.0 s and the reversed 'Keen' at 0.3 s, and the caption template '逐词显色大写 黄'. Recording in clips at 0, 5.90 (keyframe y 0 to about -0.396 in 0.4 s) and the close, with its speech audible. 01-dossie-topo.mov over the whole reel, a divider overlay with alpha from 5.90 s to the end, 00-sfx.wav at 0, 51 caption cues with word timing and the two fixes from timeline.md. Root and Timelines copies identical.
assertions: Before writing the project, CapCut being closed is checked (tasklist or equivalent) and the empty project is backed up outside the drafts folder
The first recording clip carries the reference project's entrance animation ('Balançar para cima e para a direita')
The opening sounds of the reference project are on an audio track: camera click at 0.0 s and reversed 'Keen' at 0.3 s, with their volumes
The captions use the reference project's template '逐词显色大写 黄' (51 cues with word timing), with both caption errors timeline.md points out changed (cue 26 'o lança', cue 48 'teu filho')
A divider (a line with shadow between the panel and the footage) starts at the split-screen entry 5.90 s on its own track
The recording's speech stays audible: its video material has has_sound_separated false, has_audio true and no local_id from another file
The split-screen keyframe moves the recording from y 0 to about -0.396 between 5.90 and 6.30 s, and 01-dossie-topo.mov and 00-sfx.wav start at 0

evals.name: split-per-scene-entry-and-exit
evals.prompt: monta o reel do whatsapp no capcut, já criei o projeto vazio 05-whatsapp e o capcut tá fechado. tá tudo na pasta do reel.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> whatsapp (drafts/ with an empty project made in the app named 05-whatsapp plus the author's drafts, whatsapp-tintas among them; reel/ with a clean cut rendered from the author's whatsapp-tintas main track without captions, whatsapp-tintas.srt, words.json, timeline.md and the 8 scene exports plus 00-sfx.wav). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo. Grade the draft with inspect_draft.py.
evals.expected_output: Each export at its timecode from the timeline (01 at 1.03, 02 at 3.70, 03 at 20.70, 04 at 32.80, 05 at 50.60, 06 at 66.93, 07 at 76.00, 08 at 89.17); the recording keyframed down to the lower half at the panel entry (3.70 s) and back up when the panel leaves (ending 88.40 s); a divider overlay only while the split lasts; the reference project's entrance, opening sounds and caption template; 42 caption cues; 00-sfx.wav at 0.
assertions: Before writing the project, CapCut being closed is checked and the empty project is backed up outside the drafts folder
The first recording clip carries the reference project's entrance animation and the opening sounds (click 0.0 s, 'Keen' 0.3 s) are on an audio track
The captions use the author's main caption template '逐词显色大写 黄' (42 cues with word timing)
A divider overlay covers the split screen only: it starts at the entry (3.70 s) and ends by the exit (88.40 s)
The recording moves down at 3.70 s and back to y 0 by 88.40 s with keyframes, and the eight exports start at their timeline timecodes within one frame

evals.name: no-empty-project-asks-and-stops
evals.prompt: monta no capcut o reel do celular não precisa ouvir pra mim, tá tudo na pasta do reel.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> noproject (the celular reel folder, and drafts/ with only the author's older projects: no project for this reel). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo.

No new folder is created in drafts/ and no file of an existing project in drafts/ changes

evals.name: final-mp4-split-whole-reel
evals.prompt: gera o vídeo final do reel "o celular não precisa ouvir" pronto pra postar, sem passar pelo capcut. tá tudo na pasta do reel.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> celular-mp4 (the celular reel folder and the author's drafts, Jev-AI as reference through estilo.md; no empty project). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo. Grade the mp4 against the reel the author posted (D:/Vídeos/04-celular não precisa ouvir/04-celular não precisa ouvir.mp4), frame by frame at the same times.
evals.expected_output: An mp4 of the whole reel (100.6 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps) in the reel's exports, with no CapCut project written. Frames 0 to 15 show the reference project's entrance as CapCut renders it: the frame swinging in with a directional motion blur and mirrored edges, never black corners. Captions in the reference template at the posted reel's size, breaking lines where CapCut breaks them ('APARECER POR / CAUSA', 'UMA CONVERSA / QUE', 'CONVERSA COM ELA' on one line), at y about 1645 px for the whole reel, the close included. Split-screen keyframe at 5.90 s, divider, dossier overlay, sfx and the two opening sounds.
assertions: An mp4 of the whole reel (about 100.6 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps) is written in the reel's exports and no CapCut project is written

The entrance frames (0 to 15) have no black bars (the one dark wedge in the top-right corner of frame 0 is in the posted CapCut export too) and show a directional motion blur in frames 1 to 5, like the posted reel
Caption lines break where CapCut breaks them: 'APARECER POR' over 'CAUSA' and 'UMA CONVERSA' over 'QUE', with 'CONVERSA COM ELA' on one line
Captions stay at the posted reel's height (centre about 1645 px) for the whole reel, the close after 92.9 s included
The two opening sounds (camera click at 0.0 s, reversed whoosh at 0.3 s) and 00-sfx.wav are in the mix with the speech

evals.name: jev-dynamic-capcut-split-reel
evals.prompt: monta no capcut o reel "o celular não precisa ouvir" com a dinâmica do começo do reel do Jev no vídeo todo: os punch-ins e os sons de micro-interação. criei o projeto vazio "04-celular não precisa ouvir" e fechei o capcut. tá tudo na pasta do reel.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> celular-dyn (the celular reel folder, an empty project made in the app and the author's drafts). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo; the baseline is the previous version of the skill. Gauge against the author's reference project Jev-AI, whose punch-ins are hard cuts to 1.59x and 1.68x for 0.7 to 1.0 s on a key word ('Jev' 6.73 s, 'OpenAI' 12.2 s), with the face filling the frame, each with a library sound on its first frame.
evals.expected_output: The project of scenario 1 plus punch-ins only where the face fills the frame: in the hook, after the entrance and before the split-screen entry at 5.90 s (key words such as 'microfone' 2.54 s or 'vinte e quatro horas' 4.34 s), none from 5.90 s on, where the face sits in the lower half under the panel. Each one is a hard cut to the reference's scale (about 1.6x), lowered only as far as the hook's overlays require (about 1.2 to 1.3x, author's verdict 2026-10-17: 'vale livre'), for 0.6 to 1.0 s, written as scale keyframes one frame apart, with the reference's punch-in sound (its mouse click) on the same frame. The panel's 00-sfx.wav stays as it is. Written by the skill's own assemble_draft.py from plan.json; the handover lists each punch-in.
assertions: No punch-in (recording scale above 1.0) from the split-screen entry at 5.90 s to the end; at least one punch-in in the hook, between the end of the entrance (0.5 s) and 5.90 s

Each punch-in is a hard cut held 0.6 to 1.1 s, starting within two frames of a spoken word's start in words.json, at the reference project's scale (about 1.63x) or lower only as far as it takes for the zoomed head, hair included, to stay clear of the overlays (the hook's comment print and microphone sticker sit just above the head)
Each punch-in has the reference project's punch-in sound (its mouse click) starting on the same frame, at the reference volume
The punch-ins are listed in plan.json and the project is written by the skill's own assemble_draft.py, not by an edited copy
The handover lists each punch-in with its time and word

evals.name: jev-dynamic-mp4-split-and-close
evals.prompt: gera o mp4 final do reel do whatsapp, sem capcut, com a dinâmica do começo do reel do Jev do início ao fim (punch-in e os sons de micro-interação). tá tudo na pasta do reel.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> whatsapp-dyn-mp4 (the whatsapp reel folder with the clean cut and the author's drafts; no empty project). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo; the baseline is the previous version of the skill. Gauge against the author's reference project Jev-AI, whose punch-ins are hard cuts to 1.59x and 1.68x for 0.7 to 1.0 s on a key word ('Jev' 6.73 s, 'OpenAI' 12.2 s), with the face filling the frame, each with a library sound on its first frame.
evals.expected_output: The mp4 of scenario 6 plus punch-ins only in the full-frame hook (0.5 to 3.70 s): the punch-in timeline.md suggests, 110% from 1.03 to 1.80 s on 'Mark Zuckerberg', so the finger keeps pointing at the photo. None in the split screen (3.70 to 88.40 s) and none in the closing shot (88.83 s on), which is already a close-up. Each punch-in with the reference project's punch-in sound on its first frame. Rendered by the skill's own render_mp4.py from plan.json.
assertions: No zoom of the recording in the split screen (3.70 to 88.40 s) nor in the closing close-up (88.83 s to the end)
The hook punch-in follows the timeline's suggestion: 110% from about 1.03 to 1.80 s, with the finger still pointing at the photo
Each punch-in has a short library sound of the reference project starting on its first frame
The punch-ins are listed in plan.json and the mp4 is rendered by the skill's own render_mp4.py, not by an edited copy
An mp4 of the whole reel (about 94.45 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps) is written and no CapCut project is written

evals.name: jev-dynamic-both-outputs-same-plan
evals.prompt: quero o reel do celular não precisa ouvir nas duas formas: o projeto do capcut (já criei o vazio "04-celular não precisa ouvir" e fechei o capcut) e o mp4 pronto pra postar. a mesma dinâmica do Jev nas duas, o vídeo todo.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: setup_run.sh <run> celular-both (the celular reel folder, an empty project made in the app and the author's drafts). Run with run_eval.sh from outside the repo; the baseline is the previous version of the skill. Gauge against the author's reference project Jev-AI, whose punch-ins are hard cuts to 1.59x and 1.68x for 0.7 to 1.0 s on a key word ('Jev' 6.73 s, 'OpenAI' 12.2 s), with the face filling the frame, each with a library sound on its first frame.
